visual.general_description: Axial chest CT in lung window with a dense bright consolidation and a hazy halo in one upper lung; the other lung looks clear.
visual.detailed_description: Single grayscale axial CT slice through the upper chest displayed in a lung window. A dense, bright, irregular mass-like consolidation lies in the upper part of the lung on the left side of the image, surrounded by a hazy rim of lower density grey ground-glass change; branching vessels run toward it. The central airway (trachea and main bronchi) is dark and visible in the middle of the image. The lung on the right side of the image is dark with fine vessels and no comparable focal opacity is visible. The chest wall and mediastinum are bright. Thin curved lines and a small ring-shaped marker sit outside the anterior chest wall at the top edge, and parallel horizontal bands run along the bottom edge. No letters, numbers, arrows, scale bars, patient text or dates are printed on the image.
